zh-CN: 压缩归档保留空目录，并在发布前将包内文件和目录结构与完整源清单比对。
源扫描不完整或包内内容不一致时停止发布及源文件后处理，保留原件。
en-US: Archives retain empty folders and compare their file and folder structure with the complete source manifest before publication.
An incomplete source scan or archive mismatch stops publication and source handling, preserving the originals.
